fields: [pic=8]Ahahaha! I’ll never forget the look on your face then!
[pic=2]Hah! You’d be making a face too with something that big in ya!
Hey! What are ya guys laughing at?
[pic=4]Ah, just reminiscing some good ole’ times.

Oh? You guys seem
to be getting along now.

Actually, I was curious…
How do you two get it on?
[pic=7]Usually Bucky likes to ride me. But really we did all sorts of positions…
[pic=1]Best of all is when I’m in his mouth!
[pic=4]In fact, you can join us while we celebrate!
[pic=7]Heh, you do get a kick out of that eh?
[pic=6]Yeah there’s a lot of room in there… and I’m pretty gentle…
[pic=1]It’s an absolute THRILL! You gotta try it sometime!
[pic=4]That’s right! Ole Bucky and I have buried the hatchet!
[pic=2]We won’t be getting back together of course, but we’re going to be mature about the past, and move forward.
[pic=2]See, we’ve been talking and we’ve come to realize that, though we aren’t right for each other, things definitely didn’t have to get bad between us.
[pic=2]In the heat of the moment, it can be a tough pill to swallow… But the time apart has really helped us see clearly.
[pic=1]Now frankly, I’m just glad to have my friend back!
[pic=4]It’s soooo warm and squishy! Once ya get him drooling, it’s a real mess!
[pic=5]Honestly, it was quite lonely. I don’t really have much in common with the younger folks these days…
[pic=2]And if I’m gonna be honest too… I’ve really missed that big ole tongue of yours…
[pic=4]Oh? You missed me regaling the world’s histories to you?
[pic=2]Haha, I know ole’ chap. I’ve missed that little rump of yours as well…
[pic=5]Er.. Ahem! Sorry Rascal… Didn’t mean to get all mushy in front of you…

Not a problem!
I’ll let ya guys get to it!
